observations: Black headlamp with a rechargeable battery unit and a head strap.
The battery unit has a blue LED indicator light active in photo 0.
The headlamp features a single LED bulb with a white lens.
The head strap has 'LED LIGHT' printed on it and a coiled power cable.
The unit is shown in multiple photos from different angles.
A watermark 'PEKOAUTOSFLEET' is visible across all images.

claims.evidence: The battery capacity is not clearly printed on the unit in any photo.
Photo 0 shows a blue LED light on the battery, which is a common indicator for rechargeable devices.
Photo 0 shows a bright white light output from the headlamp.
The headlamp is shown with the strap attached in all photos.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Battery may be dead or unable to hold a charge
risks.proof: A video showing the battery powering the headlamp for at least 10 minutes without a charger.

risks.risk: LED bulb may be damaged or have a poor output
risks.proof: A video showing the bulb being tested with a multimeter or a brightness test light.

risks.risk: Head strap may be broken or loose
risks.proof: A photo of the head strap with the headlamp attached.

risks.risk: Rechargeable battery may be missing or damaged
risks.proof: A photo of the battery unit with the charger and the battery itself.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the battery powering the headlamp for 10 minutes.
Video of the LED bulb being tested for brightness.
Photo of the battery unit with the charger and the battery itself.
Photo of the head strap with the headlamp attached.
response.reason: The item is a standard headlamp. It can be priced at its worst case (non-working) until proof of battery and bulb condition is provided.
